title: Kakslauttanen Lapland Trip Planning (Superman's Birthday)
context: Planning a birthday trip to Kakslauttanen Arctic Resort in Finland for Superman's birthday (Sept 6). Deciding between September 2027 or September 2028 depending on cost. Travel route: OKC → international hub (Chicago/NYC/Reykjavik/Frankfurt/Amsterdam) → Helsinki (HEL) → Ivalo (IVL) → resort shuttle. Need to monitor flight and glass igloo suite prices, as igloo suites for aurora season sell out fast. Reminder to check pricing periodically and decide on year before booking.
